tailoring.headline: Application Consultant SAP Commerce | Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years experience
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over five years of experience designing, extending and supporting SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, RESTful and OCC APIs, data integration (PIM, ERP, MDM) and performance tuning. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes and agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with strong English (C2) and German (B1) communication skills.

cover_en.subject: Application: Application Consultant SAP Commerce
cover_en.hook: I am excited about REHAU’s focus on digitalisation and sustainable e-commerce solutions. With more than five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud development at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I have delivered global customer portals, headless APIs and complex data integrations that align perfectly with your mission.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, covering product, catalog and pricing management for Rockwell Automation, ensuring platform stability and scalability.

bullets.label: Integration & APIs
bullets.text: Developed OCC REST services and built PIM-to-Hybris pipelines (Profisee, Hotfolders, DataHub) that synchronized product data across international channels, mirroring REHAU’s need for seamless ERP and MDM integration.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery
bullets.text: Led agile Scrum teams, performed code reviews, and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), guaranteeing timely releases and high-quality deliverables.

bullets.label: Production Support
bullets.text: Provided 24/7 production support, performed database query refactoring and performance tuning, and mentored junior developers, ensuring continuous operation of mission-critical e-commerce platforms.

cover_en.gap: I have not worked directly with the SAP ERP SD module nor held a formal Application Management title, but I am highly motivated to acquire this expertise and quickly adapt to REHAU’s processes.
cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15.12.2026, and can start on 16.12.2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to REHAU’s e-commerce initiatives.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Application Consultant SAP Commerce
cover_de.hook: Die digitale Transformation und Nachhaltigkeit von REHAU begeistern mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) bei Rockwell Automation und Shell habe ich globale Kundenportale, Headless-APIs und komplexe Datenintegrationen erfolgreich umgesetzt – genau die Kompetenzen, die Sie suchen.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Ich habe End-to-End-Lösungen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) entwickelt, inkl. Produkt-, Katalog- und Preisverwaltung für Rockwell Automation, und dabei Plattformstabilität und Skalierbarkeit sichergestellt.

bullets.label: Integration & APIs
bullets.text: Entwicklung von OCC-REST-Services und Aufbau von PIM-zu-Hybris-Datenpipelines (Profisee, Hotfolders, DataHub) zur Synchronisation internationaler Produktdaten, passend zu REHAUs ERP- und MDM-Anforderungen.

bullets.label: Agile Umsetzung
bullets.text: Leitung agiler Scrum-Teams, Durchführung von Code-Reviews und Ausführung von CI/CD-Deployments auf SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2), um termingerechte und qualitativ hochwertige Releases zu gewährleisten.

bullets.label: Produktionssupport
bullets.text: 24/7-Produktionssupport, Refactoring von Datenbank-Abfragen und Performance-Optimierung sowie Mentoring von Junior-Entwicklern, um den reibungslosen Betrieb kritischer E-Commerce-Plattformen sicherzustellen.

cover_de.gap: Ich habe bislang nicht mit dem SAP-ERP-Modul SD gearbeitet und keine formale Application-Management-Rolle innegehabt, bin jedoch hoch motiviert, diese Kenntnisse schnell zu erwerben und mich in REHAUs Prozesse einzuarbeiten.
cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine gültige deutsche Aufenthaltserlaubnis, befinde mich in der Kündigungsfrist bis zum 15.12.2026 und kann ab dem 16.12.2026 starten. Gerne erläutere ich in einem Gespräch, wie ich REHAU im E-Commerce-Umfeld unterstützen kann.

tailoring.why_company: REHAU’s commitment to innovative polymer solutions and its strategic focus on digitalisation, sustainability and new work align with my passion for building future-ready e-commerce platforms. Contributing to a global leader that combines material science with cutting-edge digital services excites me, and I see a strong fit for my SAP Commerce expertise to help enhance REHAU’s customer portal and drive value for its worldwide customers.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to help REHAU create a seamless, sustainable digital shopping experience for its global customers.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years experience. I’m very interested in the Application Consultant SAP Commerce role at REHAU and would love to discuss how I can contribute. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Application Consultant SAP Commerce – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Application Consultant SAP Commerce position at REHAU. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my SAP Commerce Cloud experience can add value to your team.

Best regards,
